title: How much of the world's plastic waste gets recycled?
subtitle: Split the world's plastic waste between recycling, burning, landfill and litter, then see the real share recycled and why it rarely lasts.
notes: Question changed from the brief's 'all plastic ever made': OWID's chart (OECD 2019) gives 9% of each year's waste recycled. Fix round: axis 0–100 before the ask; 'Split 100 percent … press Done'; '350 million t a year' drawn; icons no-littering / hole; 'one piece in ten'; twist as a to-scale cascade 100 → 9 → ~1 (only ~1 in 10 recycled plastic recycled twice, Geyer via OWID FAQ); payoff 'best: never made'. Left (engine): allocate's edge account bar, the drag pill over a value label, the viewer's guess not kept after the reveal.
